body.name: Finite-\(N\) all-active Gaussian bridge recursion
body.construction: At date \(t\), condition on \(\mathscr F_{N,t}\), compute the observable empirical coefficients \(\lambda_t^{N}=(K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}^{N})^{-1}K_{D_t^{\star},t}^{N}\) and \(\rho_t^{N}=K_{tt}^{N}-K_{t,D_t^{\star}}^{N}(K_{D_t^{\star}D_t^{\star}}^{N})^{-1}K_{D_t^{\star},t}^{N}\), and form \(H_{it}^{\circ,N}=(\lambda_t^{N})^{\top}H_{i,D_t^{\star}}^{\circ,N}+\sqrt{\rho_t^{N}}Z_{it}^{\circ}\). Iterate sequentially while \(\mathcal A_{N,t}^{\mathrm{act}}\) holds, recomputing messages and empirical Gram coefficients from the generated past after each update, and stop at the first exit from the all-active domain.
